title: node:sqlite
lede: Node's built-in node:sqlite, ported from Node's own src/node_sqlite.cc to TypeScript over the system libsqlite3 (linked only when a program imports the module). DatabaseSync and StatementSync are synchronous; rows are null-prototype objects, user functions, aggregates, the authorizer, sessions, serialization, tag stores and backup() all work as in Node. The one difference: Node bundles its own SQLite, while this uses the system library, so sessions and extension loading are as available as that library makes them.

entries.name: DatabaseSync
entries.signature: new DatabaseSync(path: string | Uint8Array | URL, options?: DatabaseSyncOptions)
entries.description: Opens (or creates) a database: a file path, a file: URL, or ':memory:'. Every Node option is honoured — open, readOnly, enableForeignKeyConstraints, enableDoubleQuotedStringLiterals, allowExtension, timeout, readBigInts, returnArrays, allowBareNamedParameters, allowUnknownNamedParameters, defensive.

entries.name: open / close / isOpen / isTransaction
entries.signature: db.open(): void; db.close(): void; db.isOpen: boolean; db.isTransaction: boolean
entries.description: Opening, closing and state. Closing finalizes the database's statements; using one afterwards is ERR_INVALID_STATE, as in Node.

entries.name: exec / prepare
entries.signature: db.exec(sql: string): void; db.prepare(sql: string): StatementSync
entries.description: exec runs one or more statements; prepare compiles a reusable statement.
entries.snippet: const insert = db.prepare('INSERT INTO tasks (title) VALUES (?)');

entries.name: location
entries.description: The backing file of an attached database, or null for an in-memory or temporary one.

entries.name: function
entries.signature: db.function(name: string, options?: FunctionOptions, fn: Function): void
entries.description: Registers a SQL function written in TypeScript (deterministic, directOnly, useBigIntArguments, varargs). An exception it throws is rethrown from the statement that called it.

entries.name: aggregate
entries.description: Registers an aggregate (start, step, result) or, with inverse, a window function.
entries.snippet: db.aggregate('total', { start: 0, step: (acc: number, v: number) => acc + v });

entries.name: setAuthorizer
entries.signature: db.setAuthorizer(callback: ((action: number, ...args: (string | null)[]) => number) | null): void
entries.description: Approves, denies or ignores each action SQLite compiles (sqlite.constants.SQLITE_OK/DENY/IGNORE).

entries.name: createSession / applyChangeset
entries.signature: db.createSession(options?): Session; db.applyChangeset(changeset: Uint8Array, options?): boolean
entries.description: Records changes as a changeset or patchset and applies one elsewhere, with filter and conflict handlers.
differences: Available only where the system libsqlite3 is built with sessions (macOS's is); elsewhere ERR_INVALID_STATE — Node bundles its own SQLite

entries.name: enableLoadExtension / loadExtension
entries.signature: db.enableLoadExtension(allow: boolean): void; db.loadExtension(path: string, entryPoint?: string): void
entries.description: Loads a SQLite extension, when the database was opened with allowExtension.
differences: The system libsqlite3 on macOS omits extension loading, so loading one there is ERR_INVALID_STATE — Node bundles its own SQLite

entries.name: serialize / deserialize / enableDefensive
entries.signature: db.serialize(dbName?: string): Uint8Array; db.deserialize(buffer: Uint8Array, options?): void
entries.description: Snapshots a database to bytes and restores one from them.

entries.name: createTagStore
entries.description: Prepared statements cached by tagged-template SQL.

entries.name: run / get / all / iterate
entries.signature: stmt.run(...params): { changes, lastInsertRowid }; stmt.get(...params): object | undefined; stmt.all(...params): object[]; stmt.iterate(...params): Iterator
entries.description: Rows are null-prototype objects (arrays with returnArrays); get() is undefined without a row; iterate() steps lazily.

entries.name: columns / sourceSQL / expandedSQL
entries.signature: stmt.columns(): ColumnDescription[]; stmt.sourceSQL: string; stmt.expandedSQL: string
entries.description: Each result column's name, declared type and origin database/table/column; the statement's SQL, and its SQL with the bound values.

entries.name: statement options
entries.description: Per-statement versions of the database's reading and binding options.

entries.name: Parameter binding
entries.description: Positional ? parameters, or a leading object binding :x/@x/$x (and the bare key). Numbers bind as REAL and bigints as INTEGER, as in Node.
entries.snippet: db.prepare('SELECT title FROM tasks WHERE id = :id').get({ id: 2 });

entries.name: Column value mapping
entries.signature: INTEGER → number | bigint, REAL → number, TEXT → string, BLOB → Uint8Array, NULL → null
entries.description: An INTEGER past 2^53 is ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE unless readBigInts is set.

entries.name: Errors
entries.description: SQLite failures throw an Error with code ERR_SQLITE_ERROR, errcode and errstr, as Node's.

entries.name: backup / constants
entries.signature: backup(sourceDb: DatabaseSync, path: string, options?): Promise<number>
entries.description: Copies a database into a file a few pages per turn of the event loop, reporting progress; resolves the total page count.
